qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 61.2% and operating ROIC of 89.1%. Revenue grew from $1.78B (2016) to $4.30B (2025) with EBIT margins expanding from 19.7% to 31.6%. Free cash flow conversion consistently exceeds 82% of net income ($997M Owner FCF in FY2025 vs $125M capex). Global installed base of premium chemistry and hematology instruments drives recurring diagnostic consumables, rapid assays, and cloud software (VetConnect PLUS) with >97% customer retention. Pricing power proven by 4-5% annual price increases with near-zero churn. Net debt of $195M is repayable in ~2 months of Owner FCF, with EBIT interest coverage of 35x. Diluted share count systematically reduced via disciplined FCF buybacks.
